title: [3.0 dev-b] It's no more possible to record forgotten carbs in past if earlier than 12h
body:
Yesterday morning I forgot to enter carbs for my breakfast.
Previously it's was possible, with date/time picker, to record missing entry in the past without limitation.
Now with Time Offset and Date/time linked together, it's no more possible because of the 12 hours limit in time offset...
I think it's a regression (it's important to be able to make corrections for forgotten events to have correct results in autotune, statistic...)
Can we remove time offset limitation in the past?
